blocks.content: Quiz: Which of the following statements is false?
Tap an option below to answer:
A namespace is any scope inside a C++ program.
A namespace is not just any scope; it is actually a named scope inside a C++ program.
A namespace is not just any scope; it is actually a named scope inside a C++ program.
A namespace is a named scope inside a C++ program.
A namespace can contain variables, arrays, functions, classes, etc.
We can use the same name for multiple entities as long as they are in different scopes or namespaces.
